2607.01023.title: Evidence-Supported Credit Risk Report Generation Using News-Centric Financial Knowledge Graphs
2607.01023.paper_summary: Financial markets evolve in response to real-world events reported in news, yet these drivers often remain implicit in text. To better explain market dynamics, event-market relations must be explicitly modeled through factual, company-centric, and environment-aware knowledge graphs. We present FinKG-News, a framework that automatically constructs such graphs by extracting news events as anchors linked to companies. Using FinKG-News as grounded evidence that integrates events, news, and company data, we develop an in-context learning architecture for credit risk report generation across three core financial dimensions. Automatic and human evaluations show that automated hallucination detection and quality assessment remain unreliable, making expert judgment indispensable. Our approach consistently outperforms baselines, improving quality by 19%-34% while reducing hallucinations. The source code and project resources are publicly available at: https://github.com/ichise-laboratory/FINKG-news.
2607.01023.paper_summary_zh: 金融市場會根據新聞報導的現實事件而演變，然而這些驅動因素在文本中往往是隱含的。為了更好地解釋市場動態，事件與市場的關係必須通過事實性、以公司為中心的和環境意識的知識圖譜進行明確建模。我們提出了FinKG-News，一個自動構建這類圖譜的框架，通過提取作為連結公司的錨點的新聞事件。利用FinKG-News作為整合事件、新聞和公司數據的基礎證據，我們開發了一種上下文學習架構，用於在三個核心金融維度上生成信用風險報告。自動和人工評估顯示，自動幻覺檢測和質量評估仍然不可靠，使得專家判斷不可或缺。我們的方法始終超越基準，質量提高了19%-34%，同時減少了幻覺。源代碼和項目資源可在以下網址公開獲得：https://github.com/ichise-laboratory/FINKG-news。
